findings.issue: Sense inversion: 早く来ないかなあ expresses hope that Tom DOES come soon (as expl_en/expl_pt and pt correctly state); this literal asserts the opposite wish (hoping he does not come early).
findings.current: I hope Tom doesn't come early.
findings.suggested: Tom — won't (he) come soon, I wonder (= I hope Tom comes soon).

findings.issue: Wrong institution: 中学校 is middle school / junior high (lower secondary, grades 7-9), never 'elementary school' (that is 小学校). The main en translation itself correctly says 'middle school'; the parenthetical contradicts the head gloss.
findings.current: elementary school (final stage, equivalent to lower-secondary)
findings.suggested: middle school; junior high school (lower secondary)

findings.issue: Logically inverted literal: 'the only thing I didn't do was play' means he did everything EXCEPT play games; しか + negative means he did NOTHING BUT play games. The parenthetical shows the intended meaning, but the mirror itself states the opposite.
findings.current: As for today, the only thing I didn't do was play (i.e., all I did was play).
findings.suggested: As for today, (I) did nothing but games (lit.: games-only, did not do).

findings.issue: Inverted literal: 'só jogo é que (eu) não fiz' reads as 'games are the only thing I did NOT do' (did everything except play); しか + negative means 'did nothing but games'. Only the parenthetical carries the right meaning.
findings.current: Hoje, quanto a (isso), só jogo é que (eu) não fiz... (ou seja: só fiz jogar).
findings.suggested: Quanto a hoje, (eu) não fiz (nada) além de jogo (= só fiz jogar).

findings.issue: Misses the hoping/impatience nuance of 〜ないかなあ and renders 早く as 'early': the sentence means the speaker wishes Tom would hurry up and come. It also contradicts pt ('não vem logo') and both expl fields, which commit to the hope-he-comes-soon reading.
findings.current: I wonder if Tom will come early.

findings.issue: Wrong particle restoration: the full form is 最後に髪を切ったのはいつですか — the particle omitted after nominalizer の is topic は, not が (のがいつですか is unnatural as a direct question). Teaching learners to restore が here is misleading.
findings.current: the object particle を and the particle が have been omitted
findings.suggested: the object particle を and the topic particle は (after の) have been omitted

findings.issue: Same wrong particle restoration as expl_en: the omitted particle after の is the topic marker は (最後に髪を切ったのはいつですか), not が.
findings.current: a partícula を de objeto e a partícula が foram omitidas
findings.suggested: a partícula を de objeto e a partícula は de tópico (depois de の) foram omitidas

findings.issue: Authoring metadata leaked into the learner-facing explanation: 'The target is N4 coverage.' is meaningless to students and clashes with the item's own level tag (n2). Should be deleted.
Same leaked authoring note as expl_en: 'O alvo é cobertura N4.' is internal metadata, not learner-facing content. Should be deleted.
Typo: missing space before the opening parenthesis.

Under-specified: 中学校 is specifically lower secondary, but 'escola de ensino fundamental' covers grades 1-9 and lets the reader picture a primary school. The token gloss and lit_pt correctly say 'fundamental II'; the natural pt should match.
findings.current: Meu pai ensina inglês numa escola de ensino fundamental.
findings.suggested: Meu pai ensina inglês numa escola de ensino fundamental II.
